all_text_content:
Verse of the Day
The Lord is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.
Lamentations 3:25
Quote of the Day
"As we care for each soul, we help connect them to the Savior, inviting them to be healed and transformed through His atoning blood."
Elder Gérald Caussé | 1 Apr 2026General Conference
